# Monocypher 4.0.3

Unmodified upstream src/monocypher.c, src/monocypher.h and LICENCE.md from tag 4.0.3:
https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher/tree/4.0.3

Compiled as a separate C99 static target with position-independent code. The engine uses only authenticated XChaCha20-Poly1305 and secure wiping; OS random generation/key storage belong to Engine. The upstream dual CC0/BSD license is included in LICENCE.md. Do not apply the project formatter to these vendored files.
